title: ML Weft
description:
ML Weft is an open research program from Moissanite Labs on models that keep adapting after deployment, under limits that a program can verify. This archive is the source repository: the runtime (Plasm cells, invariants, the interaction-combinator VM and BCP codec, telemetry, the ledger simulator and gateway, Aywa), its tests, the design documents, and the sources and editions of the ML Weft papers.

Source code is licensed under Apache-2.0. Documentation and the papers are licensed under CC BY 4.0; see NOTICE in the archive. The exported widgets in site/widgets/ are not included in this archive.
